description: Source file implementing functions for Metal Shader Library management and kernel execution in the MPS backend, including setting arguments, creating/deleting shader libraries, retrieving kernel functions, starting encoding, dispatching kernels, and running command blocks.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_set_arg_tensor
methods.description: Sets a tensor argument for a Metal kernel function handle.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_set_arg_int
methods.description: Sets an integer argument for a Metal kernel function handle.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_create_shader_library
methods.description: Creates a Metal shader library from source code.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_get_kernel_function
methods.description: Retrieves a cached kernel function pointer from a shader library.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_start_encoding
methods.description: Starts encoding commands for a kernel function.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_dispatch_single
methods.description: Dispatches a kernel with a specified length.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_dispatch_single_with_group_size
methods.description: Dispatches a kernel with specified length and group size.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_dispatch_array
methods.description: Dispatches a kernel with multiple lengths specified in an array.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_dispatch_array_with_group_size
methods.description: Dispatches a kernel with multiple lengths and group sizes specified in arrays.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_shared_callback
methods.description: Shared callback function for std::function trampoline.

methods.name: aoti_torch_mps_run_command_block
methods.description: Runs a command block with a callback, using a trampoline pattern.
